errors.text_span: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (97.3) exceeds the performance of Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (95.2) and o1 (94.8)
errors.evidence: Description incorrectly states that DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (97.3) exceeds Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct when it should be comparing it with DeepSeek-R1, as Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct is not in that panel.
The description does not mention the existence of visual patterns or colors used to distinguish models in the bars.
The description does not clarify the overall purpose of the comparisons between compute-optimal TTS and CoT reasoning devices.
The description fails to mention that tick marks on the MATH-500 axis are at intervals of 5 units, and intervals of 10 units on the AIME24 axis.
Does not indicate that the chart includes a legend for model identification.
